recitation.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّى اَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ ضِيْقِ الدُّنْيَا وَضِيْقِ يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ

transliteration.id: allaahumma inni a'udzubika min dzhiiqid-dunyaa wa dzhiiqi yaumal-qiyaamati
transliteration.en: allaahumma inni a'udzubika min dzhiiqid-dunyaa wa dzhiiqi yaumal-qiyaamati

translation.id: Ya Allah! Sesungguhnya aku berlindung kepada-Mu dari kesempitan dunia dan kesempitan hari kiamat.
translation.en: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the constriction of this world and the constriction of the Day of Resurrection.

body.id: Rujukan warisan: HR. Abu Daud. Catatan ini belum diverifikasi dan bukan sumber terstruktur.
body.en: Legacy citation: HR. Abu Daud. This note is unverified and is not a structured source reference.
